biography:
I'm a Licensed Civil Engineer , Certified Construction Manager, and LEED Accredited Professional in Building Design + Construction, currently working to help develop Gigawatts of Data Center capacity on behalf of my customers. 

I have over 29 years, of progressive experience overseeing all phases of multi-million dollar construction projects for mission critical, federal civilian, DoD, state & local, law enforcement, and private sector clients. I have experience with Data Center, Laboratory, Justice, Institutional, Corporate, Process, Utility, and Semiconductor projects as an Owner, Agency Construction Manager, General Contractor and Mechanical Contractor. I've accumulated detailed knowledge working on both new construction and complex renovations of occupied facilities, and on Design-Bid-Build, Design-Build, and CM-at-Risk projects. I am a LEED accredited professional with experience on projects up to LEED Platinum. I'm a talented professional possessing excellent communication skills backed by strong credentials and a proven history of safe, on-time, on-budget, high quality project completions. I am proficient in the use of standard construction related platforms and tools including Windows / MS Office, Procore, Prolog, Primavera, Adobe and Bluebeam.
